federal_reserve_board.rule: Unless otherwise indicated, information on the Board website is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission; cite the Board. Non-Board material requires permission from the non-Board source.
federal_reserve_board.engineering_use: public-domain default is favorable but series-specific/non-Board exceptions must still be checked.

eia.rule: EIA states its website data/files/databases and other information products may be used and distributed; acknowledgment including publication date is requested. Protected third-party materials remain excluded.
eia.engineering_use: strong reuse evidence for EIA-published WTI data, with attribution and protected-material checks.

ofr.rule: Federal-employee works cannot be copyrighted; credit is requested. Copyrighted third-party material must be cleared separately.
ofr.engineering_use: favorable for OFR-created output, but the FSI's proprietary underlying inputs create an unresolved privately-owned-rights risk.

series_receipts.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series_receipts.product: H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates / Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index
series_receipts.delivery_evidence: Board DDP exposes a preformatted H.10 Daily Indexes CSV and full XML; Board announced DDP retirement migration toward FRED/XML.
series_receipts.release_schedule: Monday 16:15 America/New_York for daily exchange rates and dollar indexes from the previous business week; next business day if Monday is a federal holiday.
series_receipts.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, use only an H.10 observation contained in a Board release published on or before Friday t cutoff. Current business-week observations are normally unavailable until the following Monday.
series_receipts.attribution: Cite Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: No series-specific exception identified in the reviewed H.10 release page, but the Board disclaimer preserves non-Board/private-rights caveats.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: Index methodology/indexation has changed historically; bind methodology vintage and release provenance.

series_receipts.product: Cushing, OK WTI Spot Price FOB
series_receipts.delivery_evidence: EIA publishes daily/weekly/monthly/annual history and a downloadable data file; EIA also describes its Open Data offering as free and open.
series_receipts.release_schedule: The historical price pages carry explicit Release Date / Next Release Date metadata; the observed schedule is not assumed to equal the observation date.
series_receipts.point_in_time_rule: Use only WTI observations included in an EIA release whose release date is on or before the Friday cutoff. Do not infer daily same-day availability.
series_receipts.attribution: Use an EIA acknowledgment including publication date.
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: EIA reuse notice excludes separately protected third-party materials; no such exception is treated as cleared without source-specific confirmation.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: Release-date metadata must be captured; historical corrections are possible.

series_receipts.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series_receipts.product: Financial Conditions Impulse on Growth (FCI-G), baseline monthly
series_receipts.official_delivery_page: same Board FEDS Note; baseline Monthly CSV link
series_receipts.delivery_evidence: Board publishes monthly and quarterly CSVs plus code and definitions; starting with the January 2024 release, updated estimates are provided.
series_receipts.release_schedule: Monthly output, but no fixed day/time schedule is documented in the reviewed page. Publication/version timestamp must be captured explicitly.
series_receipts.point_in_time_rule: Use a monthly FCI-G value only after the Board page/CSV version containing it was actually published. If historical publication timing cannot be reconstructed, fail closed.
series_receipts.attribution: Cite Board and the FCI-G authors/source page.
series_receipts.rights_basis: Board public-domain default for Board-created website output
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: Material. The published methodology uses private/non-Board inputs including financial and housing-market data; Board disclaimer says it does not represent that use will not infringe privately owned rights.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: Material. Board updates estimates; historical values may change and vintage tracking is required.

series_receipts.official_delivery_page: same OFR FSI page; Download all data control
series_receipts.delivery_evidence: OFR publishes a downloadable daily FSI and a revision-history file.
series_receipts.release_schedule: Daily index; OFR states published data are current from two business days prior.
series_receipts.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, use only FSI observations whose two-business-day publication lag has elapsed by cutoff, and apply any documented vintage/revision information. If release-time precision is unavailable, use the conservative lag rather than observation date.
series_receipts.attribution: Credit Office of Financial Research and use the suggested citation.
series_receipts.rights_basis: OFR federal-employee copyright rule for OFR-created work
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: High. OFR's indicator table says all underlying series are pulled from Datastream by Refinitiv and includes ICE, S&P, Cboe, MSCI, JPMorgan and other proprietary market inputs. OFR also states it does not represent that use would not infringe privately owned rights.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: High. OFR publishes revision history and has issued data-feed corrections; point-in-time vintage handling is mandatory.

series_receipts.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
series_receipts.product: H.4.1 Factors Affecting Reserve Balances / Total Assets Wednesday Level
series_receipts.delivery_evidence: Board DDP exposes H.4.1 table CSVs and full XML; release pages also expose XML/FRED migration paths.
series_receipts.release_schedule: Thursday, generally 16:30 America/New_York; next business day when publication date is a federal holiday.
series_receipts.point_in_time_rule: For Friday t, use the Wednesday level only if the corresponding Thursday H.4.1 release occurred by cutoff.
series_receipts.attribution: Cite Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: No series-specific non-Board exception identified in reviewed H.4.1 release materials.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: Release revisions/corrections must be versioned if they occur.

series_receipts.attribution: Cite Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
series_receipts.third_party_input_risk: No series-specific non-Board exception identified in reviewed H.15 release materials.
series_receipts.revision_vintage_risk: Historical revisions must be versioned if present.

summary.key_finding: v2.1C materially reduces rights friction but is not yet a complete rights-cleared candidate because FCI-G and OFR FSI are composite outputs with unresolved privately owned input implications.
